rows.title: Works well for damaged, dry skin barrier
rows.evidence_text: I've struggled with type 2 rosacea for years, where virtually every moisturizer would burn my skin. I also had a damaged skin barrier from using actives before my rosacea diagnosis, which put my skin in a bad spot, along with seb derm on the chin. I finally decided to cave and buy Dieux's instant angel since the ingredient list was so simple. Low and behold, my skin is the best it's looked in a really long time. I apply on damp skin and this stuff just locks all my serums in. It works great for slugging - add aquaphor on top of instant angel and BAM your skin is so soft and healthy the next day. Idk how this works for oily skin but on dry, sensitivity skin, it lives up to the name of "angel"

rows.title: I wanted to love this so bad
rows.evidence_text: I have been interested in Dieux skin for as long as I've been following one of the founders on Instagram. I always saw glowing reviews for Instant Angel on their site. A few "influencers" and makeup artists I love have also raved about it. I finally decided to give in when Soko Glam was having a sale.I'm mid 30s and have oily skin that I would consider pretty tough. I can pretty much put anything on my face and not have any kind of adverse reaction. I used this for maybe a week and started to notice all these little bumps and pimples crop up. I haven't broken out this bad since my early 20s. I didn't change anything else in my routine so I knew it was coming from the moisturizer. I was so so bummed and had to stop using it. I wish I saw more people talking about it potentially clogging their skin.I'm giving it 2 stars because it was a really beautiful light cream texture and I appreciate the aluminum packaging. I no longer use it on my face but it does make a lovely hand cream.

rows.title: Great product, just know your eye skin
rows.evidence_text: So, i got this product for the reviews and for the ingredients listed and for what I needed for my eye skin. My eyes have been super dry and skin will peel, along with that i had some pretty bad dark circles and fine lines, and i patch tested this product on the wrist on my right forearm and the first time i thought it stung a little but it went away and every other time i used it i had no issue on my arm, it looked like it was doing exactly what i bought it for. So yesterday i put it on my eyelids, and it burned. And after a bit the burning went away. Same thing with last night and this morning. And i’m not sure if it’s the product or if it’s my eyelids. My guess is my eyelids are too dry or the skin barrier on them is too compromised so even this gentle eye cream is affecting my eye skin. I’m not sure but i feel like it isn’t the product if it did so well on my forearm. Like i think maybe i have eye eczema genuinely because my eyes have been so dry for months and i never thought anything of it. So my review for this product is that it is good, but if you might have eye eczema, maybe talk to your dermatologist first. My only problem is the temporary burning sensation so i am gonna keep using for a couple more days and see if it negatively affects, or positively affects my skin regardless of the burning. The reason i make that choice is because, when my hands are bone dry and i put lotion on they burn like hell, but i stick it out because my hand genuinely needs the moisture…
